root_cause: scripts/innovation/hpc_specs.py::_HEADER contained a hardcoded `cd /home/sychan552/scratch/CHATTIME/Chattime`, a legacy line inherited from the original ablation workflow (pre-dating the isolated-deployment policy and never revisited in innov-v2.1/v2.2/v2.3). Every generated script inherited it, so the four pilots, the worker and the submit driver would all have executed from the forbidden original reproduction repository.
why_the_runtime_guard_correctly_blocked_: runtime_guard.py is invoked with --deployment-root "${INNOVATION_DEPLOYMENT_ROOT:-$(pwd)}"; with the forbidden `cd` in place $(pwd) resolved to the banned root, the guard reported 1 violation and exited 2, so the pilot would have aborted with FORBIDDEN_ORIGINAL_REPOSITORY_RUNTIME_IMPORT before any training. The guard was fail-closed and correct; the defect was purely in the generated scripts. Because of that, no v2.3 pilot was ever submitted and no erroneous training result exists.
